narration: You downloaded a round-up savings app and felt like a financial genius. But nobody told you to do the one math problem that changes everything.
visual: Smartphone with round-up app icon, gold coins falling around it. Title text 'ROUND-UP TRAP' springs in. Dark background.

narration: Most of these apps charge three dollars a month — that's $36 every year just to use the app. The average light user rounds up about $30 to $40 total.
visual: Large '$3/MO' fee label springs in red on light background. Calendar grid of 12 months appears, each labeled $3. '= $36/YEAR' reveals below. 'vs $30-40 SAVED' fades in.

narration: Do the math — you're paying $36 in fees to save $35. That's basically a one-hundred-percent fee ratio. You're paying the app more than you're actually saving.
visual: Balance scale SVG on dark background. Left pan tilts lower labeled '$36 FEES' in red, right pan rises labeled '$35 SAVED' in green. '100% FEE RATIO' text fades in below.

narration: Now to be fair — heavy card swippers can round up enough to clear the fee. But two-thirds of users are light spenders, and for them the app is just a subscription dressed up as savings.
visual: Animated bar chart on light background. 'LIGHT SPENDER' bar falls short of the $36 fee line. 'HEAVY SPENDER' bar clears it. '2/3 of users' callout label fades in.

narration: Here's the real cost. That $36 a year, invested directly in an index fund for thirty years at eight percent, grows to four-thousand four-hundred dollars. The app didn't build your wealth — it ate it.
visual: Side-by-side comparison on dark background. Left: small pink piggy bank labeled 'WITH APP — ≈$0 net'. Right: large green piggy bank labeled 'DIRECT INVEST — $4,400'. '30 YEARS LATER' header.

narration: Every major brokerage — Fidelity, Schwab, Vanguard — lets you auto-invest any amount for zero fees. Ditch the middleman. Your spare change deserves to work for you, not against you.
visual: Light background. '$0 IN FEES' in large green text. Three circular brokerage logos appear. Green CTA button: 'DITCH THE MIDDLEMAN — Auto-invest free, keep 100% of your gains'.
